summary.en: An LPG access scheme for eligible women from poor households; current eligibility and benefits must be checked on the official portal.
summary.te: అర్హ పేద కుటుంబాల మహిళలకు LPG కనెక్షన్ అందించే పథకం.
summary.hi: पात्र गरीब परिवारों की महिलाओं को LPG कनेक्शन देने की योजना।

benefits: LPG connection support as specified by current official rules.
required_documents: Identity and household documents requested by an authorized distributor
how_to_apply: Check current eligibility and apply through an authorized LPG distributor or official portal.
helpline: Use the contact details published on the official portal.
